title: FAST五百公尺球面電波望遠鏡
titleEn: Five Hundred Meter Aperture Spherical Telescope FAST
summary: 以「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與轉換
stages.description: 單元1–2：可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域
stages.descriptionEn: Units 1–2: Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture
stages.route: 依序完成機制、估算、驗證與診斷；這是學習路徑，不是現場操作順序。
stages.routeEn: Complete mechanism, estimate, verification and diagnosis as a learning path, not an operating sequence.

steps.title: 單元1｜繞射角尺度：機制與界面
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Diffraction angular scale: Mechanism and interfaces
steps.objective: 以「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」完成機制與界面並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete mechanism and interfaces for Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」。畫出「天線 → 接收機 → 時鐘與基線 → 相關器 → 校準源」並圈出與「繞射角尺度」有關的介面。將 1.22*wavelength/aperture 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：理想圓孔的第一暗環角尺度約為1.22倍波長除口徑。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.instructionEn: The case focus is Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture. Draw Antenna → Receiver → Clock and baseline → Correlator → Calibration source and mark the interfaces relevant to Diffraction angular scale. Place every variable of 1.22*wavelength/aperture on the drawing with units, direction and provenance. Explain: For an ideal circular aperture, the first dark-ring angle is about 1.22 wavelength divided by aperture. Identify what it cannot establish: This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.observation: 對照「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」，輸入變數與量測結果不同：先定義可觀察量，再決定能否使用這個式子。前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
steps.observationEn: For Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture, distinguish inputs from observed outcomes before deciding whether this equation applies. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.
steps.failure: 全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑；不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.failureEn: Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing; This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.check: 提交標註介面圖及變數表；每個變數有單位與假設/來源/量測標籤，並明列「不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit the interface diagram and variable table with units and assumed/sourced/measured labels, explicitly recording: This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.

steps.title: 單元1｜繞射角尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Diffraction angular scale: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」的「繞射角尺度」採以下合成教學值：wavelength=5e-07 m；aperture=0.1 m。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 1.22*wavelength/aperture；獨立基準為 6.1e-06 rad。把 wavelength 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 6.71e-06 rad。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture, use synthetic inputs for Diffraction angular scale: wavelength=5e-07 m；aperture=0.1 m. Check dimensions before evaluating 1.22*wavelength/aperture; the independent benchmark is 6.1e-06 rad. Increase wavelength by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 6.71e-06 rad. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: wavelength增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 6.1e-07 rad。不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 6.1e-07 rad. This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.failure: 全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑；不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.failureEn: Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing; This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.check: 原值重算與 6.1e-06 rad 相符；10%案例與 6.71e-06 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 6.1e-06 rad at baseline and 6.71e-06 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（rad）？
quiz.explanation: 按 1.22*wavelength/aperture 逐項代入，結果為 6.1e-06；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into 1.22*wavelength/aperture gives 6.1e-06; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜繞射角尺度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Diffraction angular scale: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」設計「繞射角尺度」的獨立驗證：在合成點像比較兩口徑，另列感測器像素與抖動造成的展寬。 合成基線資料加入已知相位與增益偏差，再確認校正能回復參考。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture, independently verify Diffraction angular scale: Compare synthetic point images at two apertures and separate pixel and jitter broadening. Inject known phase and gain errors into synthetic baselines and verify recovery of the reference. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑；不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.failureEn: Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing; This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 保留原始資料並執行：在合成點像比較兩口徑，另列感測器像素與抖動造成的展寬。
只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
optionsEn: Retain raw data and perform: Compare synthetic point images at two apertures and separate pixel and jitter broadening.
Retain only a PASS label.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。」。

steps.title: 單元1｜繞射角尺度：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Diffraction angular scale: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑」。以本單元「繞射角尺度」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「在合成點像比較兩口徑，另列感測器像素與抖動造成的展寬。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing. For Diffraction angular scale, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Compare synthetic point images at two apertures and separate pixel and jitter broadening. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑」不是單靠 6.1e-06 rad 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 6.1e-06 rad alone cannot exclude Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑；不是含像差、抖動、大氣與像素取樣的整機解析度。
steps.failureEn: Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing; This is not system resolution including aberrations, jitter, atmosphere and pixel sampling.
steps.check: 交付單元1的五項證據包；清楚寫出「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 1, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture and retaining failed cases.

steps.title: 單元2｜相位差：機制與界面
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Phase difference: Mechanism and interfaces
steps.objective: 以「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」完成機制與界面並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete mechanism and interfaces for Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」。畫出「天線 → 接收機 → 時鐘與基線 → 相關器 → 校準源」並圈出與「相位差」有關的介面。將 2*pi*path/wavelength 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：光程差除波長乘2π得到相位差，完整相位須區分週期包絡。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：不同路徑折射率與頻寬會影響相干性，不能只比較幾何長度。

Draw Antenna → Receiver → Clock and baseline → Correlator → Calibration source and mark the interfaces relevant to Phase difference. Place every variable of 2*pi*path/wavelength on the drawing with units, direction and provenance. Explain: Path difference divided by wavelength times 2π gives phase; distinguish full phase from wrapped phase. Identify what it cannot establish: Refractive index and bandwidth affect coherence; geometry alone is insufficient.

steps.failure: 全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑；不同路徑折射率與頻寬會影響相干性，不能只比較幾何長度。
steps.failureEn: Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing; Refractive index and bandwidth affect coherence; geometry alone is insufficient.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」的「相位差」採以下合成教學值：path=1e-06 m；wavelength=2e-06 m。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 2*pi*path/wavelength；獨立基準為 3.14159265 rad。把 path 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 3.45575192 rad。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture, use synthetic inputs for Phase difference: path=1e-06 m；wavelength=2e-06 m. Check dimensions before evaluating 2*pi*path/wavelength; the independent benchmark is 3.14159265 rad. Increase path by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 3.45575192 rad. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: path增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 0.314159265 rad。不同路徑折射率與頻寬會影響相干性，不能只比較幾何長度。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 0.314159265 rad. Refractive index and bandwidth affect coherence; geometry alone is insufficient.
steps.failure: 全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑；不同路徑折射率與頻寬會影響相干性，不能只比較幾何長度。
steps.failureEn: Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing; Refractive index and bandwidth affect coherence; geometry alone is insufficient.
steps.check: 原值重算與 3.14159265 rad 相符；10%案例與 3.45575192 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 3.14159265 rad at baseline and 3.45575192 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（rad）？
quiz.explanation: 按 2*pi*path/wavelength 逐項代入，結果為 3.14159265；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into 2*pi*path/wavelength gives 3.14159265; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 原理與模型
knowledge.text: 光程差除波長乘2π得到相位差，完整相位須區分週期包絡。
knowledge.textEn: Path difference divided by wavelength times 2π gives phase; distinguish full phase from wrapped phase.

knowledge.title: 案例與驗證界限
knowledge.text: 可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域。不同路徑折射率與頻寬會影響相干性，不能只比較幾何長度。 前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
knowledge.textEn: Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture. Refractive index and bandwidth affect coherence; geometry alone is insufficient. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.

steps.title: 單元2｜相位差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Phase difference: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」設計「相位差」的獨立驗證：以一個波長增量測試相位回到同一包絡值，另保存未包絡相位。 合成基線資料加入已知相位與增益偏差，再確認校正能回復參考。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture, independently verify Phase difference: Add one wavelength to test wrapped-phase equivalence while retaining unwrapped phase. Inject known phase and gain errors into synthetic baselines and verify recovery of the reference. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑；不同路徑折射率與頻寬會影響相干性，不能只比較幾何長度。
steps.failureEn: Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing; Refractive index and bandwidth affect coherence; geometry alone is insufficient.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不同路徑折射率與頻寬會影響相干性，不能只比較幾何長度。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Refractive index and bandwidth affect coherence; geometry alone is insufficient.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
保留原始資料並執行：以一個波長增量測試相位回到同一包絡值，另保存未包絡相位。
optionsEn: Retain only a PASS label.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: Add one wavelength to test wrapped-phase equivalence while retaining unwrapped phase.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不同路徑折射率與頻寬會影響相干性，不能只比較幾何長度。」。
quiz.explanationEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Refractive index and bandwidth affect coherence; geometry alone is insufficient.

steps.title: 單元2｜相位差：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Phase difference: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑」。以本單元「相位差」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「以一個波長增量測試相位回到同一包絡值，另保存未包絡相位。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing. For Phase difference, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Add one wavelength to test wrapped-phase equivalence while retaining unwrapped phase. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑」不是單靠 3.14159265 rad 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 3.14159265 rad alone cannot exclude Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑；不同路徑折射率與頻寬會影響相干性，不能只比較幾何長度。
steps.failureEn: Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing; Refractive index and bandwidth affect coherence; geometry alone is insufficient.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「可變形反射面、饋源艙與照射區域」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Active reflector, feed cabin and illuminated aperture and retaining failed cases.

全部口徑被當成任意指向有效口徑
以獨立量測檢核「相位差」。
optionsEn: Record unexplained discrepancies as unresolved.
Full diameter treated as effective aperture at every pointing
Check Phase difference with independent measurements.
